facts.statement: The genus is known from a holotype consisting of a well-preserved left maxilla, plus referred materials including an isolated maxillary tooth and a braincase.
facts.quote: Siamodon is known from the holotype PRC-4, a well-preserved left maxilla and from the referred materials PRC-5, an isolated maxillary tooth and PRC-6, a braincase.

facts.statement: Fossils were collected from the Khok Kruat Formation in Nakhon Ratchasima Province, dating to the Aptian stage of the late Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 to 113 million years ago.
facts.quote: It was collected in the Ban Saphan Hin site, Nakhon Ratchasima Province, from the Khok Kruat Formation, dating to the Aptian stage of the late Early Cretaceous, about 125-113 million years ago.

facts.statement: The maxilla is shaped like an isosceles triangle with a strong longitudinal bulge on its medial surface and bears at least 25 teeth with a prominent median primary ridge and mamillated denticles on the crown margins.
facts.quote: Siamodon shows a combination of plesiomorphic and apomorphic features, including a maxilla shaped like an isosceles triangle, with the dorsal process located at about mid-length of the bone; a strong longitudinal bulge on the medial surface of the maxilla; at least 25 maxillary teeth, which bear a prominent median primary ridge, and one short weak subsidiary ridge or no subsidiary ridge at all, and mamillated denticles on the crown margins.

facts.statement: The holotype maxilla measures 230 millimeters in length and 100 millimeters in height.
facts.quote: The maxilla is 230 millimeters long, and has a height of 100 millimeters.

facts.statement: An isolated maxillary tooth has a height of about 25 to 28 millimeters and a width of about 14 to 17 millimeters.
facts.quote: The height of the isolated tooth is about 25-28 millimeters, and the width is about 14-17 millimeters.

facts.statement: The genus was first named by Éric Buffetaut and Varavudh Suteethorn in 2011.
facts.quote: Siamodon was first named by Éric Buffetaut and Varavudh Suteethorn in 2011.

facts.statement: The specific name nimngami honors Witaya Nimngam, who donated the specimens to the researchers.
facts.quote: The specific name is in honour of Witaya Nimngam, who donated the specimens to the authors.

facts.statement: Siamodon is classified within the parent group Hadrosauriformes.
Siamodon belongs to the class Ornithischia.
The time range for Siamodon is the Aptian stage, from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Siamodon is an extinct genus of iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur found in Early Cretaceous deposits in northeastern Thailand.
rejected.quote: Siamodon is an extinct genus of iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur from Early Cretaceous deposits of northeastern Thailand.

rejected.statement: Based on maxillary characters, Siamodon belongs to a group of iguanodontians that are more derived than Iguanodon but basal to Hadrosauridae.
rejected.quote: The combination of characters seen in the maxilla of Siamodon nimngami indicate that it belongs to a group of iguanodontians more derived than Iguanodon but basal to Hadrosauridae.
